results.name: Visible hero, headings, photo cards and statistics never receive pending opacity or reveal animations
Reload with all page content in the initial viewport preserves every number without any entrance effect
Only elements fully below the initial viewport are pending; partially visible and above-screen content remain visible
Offscreen entrance is anticipated by 120px, plays once and always releases pending
Reveal uses transform independently of hover/ambient translate and preserves an existing transform
Offscreen counters start at zero while the card is still pending, then restore exact final values
Initial visible counter keeps its exact final value even after observer events and scrolling
Failed WAAPI reveal releases pending immediately and cannot leave content invisible
Missing WAAPI or IntersectionObserver leaves content visible with final counters
Missing IntersectionObserver never prepares hidden content
Reduced motion at startup prepares no hidden elements or animated counters
Switching to reduced motion releases all pending content, cancels active entrances and restores final counters
Keyboard focus immediately reveals a pending ancestor without fading focused content
Keyboard focus cancels an active or delayed reveal so the focused target is immediately visible
Hero ambient movement writes offsets only to the two photos and resets on reduced motion
Revealing while document is hidden releases pending without a delayed opacity reset
Module remains idempotent and loading it again adds no observer or animation
GTM, exact Socio Moto/Instagram links, email and versioned motion assets are preserved without running GTM

scope: Focused DOM/state tests for first-paint/reveal behavior with synthetic viewport geometry, IntersectionObserver and Web Animations API mocks.
limits: No browser pixels or original user video reproduction; visual smoothness and browser paint ordering require browser QA.
Only motion.js is evaluated. GTM and other external scripts are not executed, and no analytics requests are made.
